evidence.detail: The abstract class extends R112 InteractiveClientOverlay and supplies the shared render/input implementation for exactly two concrete subclasses: rs/l/e/a/r and rs/l/e/a/t.
It renders a 40x40 LOW-layer prompt using normal/hover sprites, animated alpha between 100 and 200, stacked positioning through the global overlay counter, and subclass-provided colors/action label.

Its interaction hook performs hit-testing against the prompt rectangle, tracks press/release state, invokes the subclass action only on a completed click, and returns true while the prompt owns the interaction so normal client menu construction is intercepted.
Subclasses provide sprite setup, click action, two presentation colors and the hover/action text, fixing this as a reusable clickable action prompt rather than a generic overlay.
